qualifier: pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
name: Pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members cover pyrimidine de novo synthesis, salvage and breakdown plus deoxyribonucleotide/dNTP synthesis and turnover (including nucleoside-analogue drug handling), whereas the confusables centre on purine ribonucleotide de novo synthesis, purine salvage or nucleoside transport.

qualifier: biosynthesis and homeostatic regulation
name: Sphingolipid biosynthesis and homeostatic regulation
rationale: All members concern sphingolipid (ceramide, sphingoid, sphingomyelin) synthesis, turnover and its regulation (obsolete amide/membrane-lipid terms are parents of these), while confusables add TNFR1-driven ceramide production, sphingomyelin catabolism or ER–Golgi lipid transfer.

qualifier: droplet biogenesis and fatty acid/triglyceride homeostasis
name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: Members describe lipid droplet formation, fusion and organization together with triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis, distinguishing the theme from confusables focused on lipophagy/droplet disassembly or LXR-driven transcription.

qualifier: chemokine receptor control of monocyte trafficking
name: Chemokine receptor control of monocyte and leukocyte trafficking
rationale: Members combine chemokine–receptor binding modules with regulation of monocyte, macrophage and NK chemotaxis and CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte modules, whereas confusables emphasize monocyte activation, endothelial adhesion/extravasation or CCR1/7 signalling.

qualifier: exploratory behavior and reward conditioning
name: Social, exploratory and reward-conditioned behavior
rationale: Members are organism-level behaviors (mating, parental, aggressive, grooming, exploration, drinking) plus conditioned place preference, operant conditioning and nicotine/ethanol responses, while confusables add stress-hormone, sleep/wake, neuropeptide or cocaine-response terms.

qualifier: receptor processing and NOTCH1-4 intracellular-domain transcription
name: Canonical Notch1-4 processing and nuclear transcriptional signaling
rationale: Members cover Notch receptor proteolytic processing, signal transmission to the nucleus and NICD-driven transcription across NOTCH1-4, with Notch-dependent contexts (Th2, pancreatic bud), while confusables lack paralog transcription or processing and focus on NOTCH1 PEST/FBXW7 mutants or noncanonical NOTCH3/4.

core: Innate receptor NF-kB and stress kinase signaling
qualifier: TLR/NOD-driven, including noncanonical NF-kB
name: TLR/NOD-driven canonical and noncanonical NF-kB, p38/JNK activation
rationale: Members describe TLR, NOD1/2 and TNFSF-triggered IKK/NF-kB (canonical and NIK-noncanonical), TAK1-p38/JNK activation and IKK-deficiency diseases, distinguishing them from confusables built around TNFR1, linear ubiquitination or TBK1/IRF3.

qualifier: nephron and tubule segment differentiation
name: Embryonic kidney nephron and tubule segment development
rationale: Members span nephric duct, metanephric mesenchyme, renal vesicle/comma/S-shaped body and tubule segment (loop of Henle, distal tubule, collecting duct) development, whereas confusables emphasize ureteric bud formation and organ induction.

qualifier: fibronectin matrix, focal adhesion and fibroblast migration
name: Fibronectin matrix, focal adhesion and fibroblast migration
rationale: Members concern fibronectin matrix assembly, integrin production, focal adhesion assembly, SRF-linked cytoskeletal remodelling and fibroblast migration, while confusables emphasize integrin/syndecan surface interactions, stress fibres or EMT/stromal programmes.

qualifier: endothelial fate, arteriovenous specification and vessel maturation
name: Endothelial fate, arteriovenous specification and vessel maturation
rationale: Members cover vasculogenesis, endothelial fate and arterial/venous/lymphatic differentiation, artery morphogenesis and vascular smooth muscle maturation, distinguishing them from confusables centred on outflow tract, valves, pulmonary vessels or BMP signalling.

qualifier: metallothionein detoxification and redox control
name: Metal ion response, metallothionein detoxification and redox control
rationale: Members are responses to copper, zinc, manganese, iron, cobalt, lead, mercury and selenium with MTF1/metallothionein detoxification and redox/HMOX1 restraint, whereas confusables focus on cadmium, ROS detoxification, ferroptosis or xenobiotic AhR responses.

qualifier: docking, priming and transmitter-specific release cycles
name: Calcium-triggered neurotransmitter vesicle docking, priming and release
rationale: Members describe synaptic vesicle docking, SNARE assembly, priming and Ca2+-dependent fusion plus the release cycles for glutamate, acetylcholine and monoamines, distinguishing them from confusables on active-zone structure, inhibitory modulation or cholinergic neuromuscular transmission.

qualifier: peroxide and nitrosative stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
name: Peroxide and nitrosative stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis regulation
rationale: Members are responses to hydrogen peroxide, hydroperoxide, nitric oxide and reactive nitrogen species and regulation of the resulting intrinsic apoptosis, while confusables bring in ferroptosis, mitochondrial respiration and ischemia/oxygen metabolism.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin and chloride transport, osmotic response
name: Water-salt homeostasis via vasopressin, aquaporins and chloride transport
rationale: Members cover renal water absorption, vasopressin signalling, aquaporin and urea/glycerol transport, cation-chloride and CFTR chloride transport, sodium/potassium handling and osmotic stress responses, whereas confusables centre on aldosterone synthesis, P-type ATPase ion gradients or Na+/H+ exchangers.

core: Glutathione and sulfur amino acid metabolism
qualifier: with vitamin B6/molybdenum cofactors and aldehyde detoxification
name: Glutathione-cysteine metabolism, B6 cofactors and aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members combine glutathione synthesis, recycling and transport, cysteine/sulfide metabolism, vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor synthesis and methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification, while confusables emphasize selenium metabolism, transsulfuration or ROS/NADPH redox.

qualifier: MITF-regulated, with UV and blue-light response
name: MITF-regulated melanocyte pigmentation and light response
rationale: Members cover MITF-M target programmes, melanin synthesis, pigment granule localization, melanocyte proliferation/differentiation and responses to UV-A and blue light, distinguishing them from confusables on melanosome assembly or MITF cell-cycle/DNA-repair targets.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA control of glycogen, glucokinase and triglyceride
name: Hormonal control of glycogen, glucokinase and triglyceride mobilization
rationale: Members describe glucagon/PKA, adiponectin, AMPK and PDE3B regulation of glycogen synthesis/breakdown, glucokinase activity and triglyceride lipolysis, whereas confusables centre on ChREBP/glucose-driven transcription, gluconeogenesis and insulin responsiveness.

qualifier: HDAC/NCoR repression and sensorimotor function
name: MECP2-HDAC neuronal gene repression and sensorimotor function
rationale: Members are dominated by MECP2 regulation, loss-of-function variants and HDAC/NCoR-linked repression of neuronal genes with Rett-relevant sensory and translational phenotypes, distinguishing them from confusables of general locomotor/learning behaviors without MECP2.

qualifier: NOTCH3/4 and p75NTR
name: Intramembrane proteolytic signaling of NOTCH3/4 and p75NTR
rationale: Members describe receptor intracellular-domain cleavage for noncanonical NOTCH3/NOTCH4 and for p75NTR with NRIF nuclear death signalling, whereas confusables involve NOTCH1/2 activation or ERBB4 cleavage.

qualifier: convergent extension in embryonic morphogenesis
name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension in embryonic morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover PCP protein localization and Wnt/PCP signalling with convergent extension in gastrulation, axis elongation, organogenesis and neural plate shaping, while confusables emphasize noncanonical Wnt receptor internalization, axial mesoderm or midline patterning.

qualifier: sleep-wake, stress and social behavior
name: Neuropeptide control of sleep-wake, stress and social behavior
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/relaxin/orexin receptor signalling with sleep-wake regulation, CRH/corticosterone stress responses and mating, parental and aggressive behavior, distinguishing them from confusables centred on reward conditioning or opioid/dense-core vesicle signalling.

qualifier: Th2, mast cell and eosinophil effector responses
name: Th2, mast cell and eosinophil type 2 allergic immunity
rationale: Members cover Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13/33 signalling, FcepsilonRI mast cell activation, eosinophil biology, IgE switching and type I hypersensitivity, whereas confusables are other interleukin families (IL-2/7/10/12/23, IL-6 type).

qualifier: follicle growth, oocyte maturation and luteal regression
name: Ovarian follicle, oocyte maturation and luteal cycle
rationale: Members describe antral follicle growth, oocyte meiotic maturation, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis and the estrous cycle, distinguishing them from confusables built on gonadotropin hormone secretion and FSH/LH receptor responses.

qualifier: telomerase-independent replication, capping and recombination control
name: Telomerase-independent telomere replication, capping and recombination control
rationale: Members cover telomere C-strand synthesis, semi-conservative replication, capping, end protection from NHEJ, D-loop/t-circle and recombination control, whereas confusables emphasize telomerase extension/Cajal body trafficking or general DNA topology.

qualifier: formyl peptide and complement receptor-driven
name: Formyl peptide and complement receptor-driven neutrophil recruitment
rationale: Members describe formyl peptide receptor and chemoattractant GPCR responses driving neutrophil/granulocyte chemotaxis and recruitment, with complement receptor signalling distinguishing the theme from confusables on extravasation or chemokine production.
